hyperedges.label: Participate space combining idea board and weekly prompt

nodes.label: Rotaract Club of Vishwahita
nodes.rationale: Official digital home product for RI District 3234 Group 01 Chennai; solves low event frequency and low participation.

nodes.label: Rotary Club of Madras Industrial City
nodes.norm_label: rotary club of madras industrial city

nodes.label: Vishwahita (universal friendship)
nodes.rationale: Sanskrit name sense is the operating principle, not merely a tagline.

nodes.label: Official House + Clubroom (Approach 1)
nodes.rationale: Approved product shape (D8): three layers one brand — Public House, Member Clubroom, Admin CMS. Public stays professional; interaction for small club lives behind login.

nodes.label: Public House
nodes.rationale: Routes /, /events, /projects/*, /contact, auth. Job: story, proof, contact, join for visitors, prospects, officials.

nodes.label: Member Clubroom
nodes.rationale: Routes /member/* for signed-in members: RSVP, Participate, Learn tutorial.

nodes.label: Admin CMS
nodes.rationale: Gated by publicMetadata.role === admin; edit all content types without developer for routine edits.

nodes.label: Supabase (Postgres + RLS)
nodes.rationale: D7: Keep Supabase. Strong fit for CMS + relational (events↔RSVP, forms↔responses), ISR/revalidate marketing pages, storage/SQL. Do not migrate to Convex unless clubroom becomes highly collaborative real-time and rewrite cost is accepted.

nodes.label: Convex migration (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Convex better for heavy real-time multiplayer, not CMS + light member ops. Explicit non-goal for v1.

nodes.label: Participate space (A + D)
nodes.rationale: D11: Idea board (A) and weekly president prompt (D) framed as one Participate space behind login.

nodes.label: Weekly president prompt (D)
nodes.rationale: President posts one question/week; members answer once; existing pulse model; low-friction weekly habit.

nodes.label: Idea board (A)
nodes.rationale: Members post ideas; one upvote per user; statuses new|under_review|planned|done|declined; comments off in v1.

nodes.label: Learn new-member tutorial
nodes.rationale: Soft gate only in v1 (D15): encourage with banner/checklist, do not hard-block RSVP. Store tutorial_completed_at on user.

nodes.label: Soft tutorial gate (v1 default)
nodes.rationale: Club is low-activity; friction kills turnout. Revisit hard gate only if president demands it.

nodes.label: Route /hub → /member redirect
nodes.rationale: D17: Evolve /hub to /member; redirect after cutover.

nodes.label: Legacy spotlight (one flagship project)
nodes.rationale: Exactly one is_legacy flagship project; not a third calendar type.

nodes.label: Logo + name intro into sticky nav
nodes.rationale: First paint centered logo+name; on scroll or ~1.2s rise into sticky nav; one calm motion; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
nodes.norm_label: logo + name intro into sticky nav

nodes.label: Remove particle/connector backgrounds
nodes.rationale: D13: Remove tsparticles, connecting webs, dense noise, multi-aura clutter; quiet professional surfaces.

nodes.label: Honest content rules
nodes.rationale: No invented metrics, fake testimonials, or fake online counts. Real club facts only. Prefer placeholders or omit over fabrication.

nodes.label: 90-day success priorities
nodes.rationale: D9 order: (1) public story/join (2) weekly member habit (3) real-event turnout (4) admin power. No vanity metrics.

nodes.label: Public density Option C (multi-page)
nodes.rationale: D10: Dynamic multi-page energy, not one infinite homepage dump; carousels deep-link to full pages.

nodes.label: Tone: luxury + editorial
nodes.rationale: D4: Prestige + service; not playful NGO, not SaaS. Uniqueness from story + structure + real facts (D5).

nodes.label: Brand tokens Midnight Cranberry Gold Ivory
nodes.norm_label: brand tokens midnight cranberry gold ivory

nodes.label: 2026-07-16 clubhouse design spec
nodes.rationale: D14: Spec supersedes earlier kitchen-sink homepage density where they conflict; authoritative product design.

nodes.label: v1 non-goals
nodes.rationale: No public social feed, fake live presence, Convex migration, multi-tier board roles, gamification badges, particle/3D systems, hard tutorial gate.

nodes.label: Cranberry Focus Rule (≤15%)
nodes.rationale: Cranberry used exclusively as focal accent on less than 15% of any screen surface to preserve energetic premium impact.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: Digital Instrument of Leadership
nodes.rationale: High-contrast midnight aesthetic blending Rotary credibility with modern youth-led refinement; motion like watchmaker ateliers and premium editorial journals.
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: digital instrument of leadership

nodes.label: Tactile Rest Rule (glass panels)
nodes.rationale: Glass panels remain flat at rest with subtle 1px white/10 border; lift and glow exclusively on hover.

nodes.label: Product purpose: premium official digital home
nodes.rationale: Showcase Chennai initiatives, drive member collaboration inside Hub, encourage sponsorships and new member sign-ups.
nodes.norm_label: product purpose: premium official digital home

nodes.label: Problem: few events + low participation
nodes.rationale: Current public site risks visual/content bloat (particles, too many homepage sections) undercutting credibility and weekly return habit.

nodes.label: Edit any content type (CMS interpretation)
nodes.rationale: v1: every content type the UI shows is CMS-editable; not freeform HTML injection of every layout pixel.

nodes.label: Club newspaper homepage (interim)
nodes.rationale: Homepage club-newspaper redesign is a step toward Phase 1; full spec supersedes density where they conflict.

nodes.label: SEO claim: 500+ projects / 2000+ reached
nodes.rationale: Landing SEO copy cites 500+ projects and 2000+ people; conflicts with honest-content rules unless president-confirmed — treat carefully vs term report of 15 projects/500 beneficiaries.

nodes.label: GEMINI cinematic landing page builder
nodes.rationale: Generic cinematic 1:1 landing builder with noise overlay and particle-like density; conflicts with clubhouse Phase 0 visual calm and remove-particles decision for this product.

nodes.label: Approach A: Extend & Enrich
nodes.rationale: Build on existing Next.js/Clerk/Supabase codebase rather than rewrite.

nodes.label: Noir & Gold Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark void #08080F, gold gradient #C9A84C→#FFD97D matching club logo; light cream #FAFAF4 zones alternate on scroll.

nodes.label: Scroll-Driven Theme Inversion Engine
nodes.rationale: ThemeProvider + GSAP ScrollTrigger set dark|light per section; navbar and CSS variables invert in sync (0.9s power3.inOut).

nodes.label: Community Luxe positioning
nodes.rationale: Bridge high-end creative agency aesthetic with dedicated NGO roots; cinema-grade club site.

nodes.label: Navbar Announcement Unread Badge
nodes.rationale: Unread count via localStorage last-seen timestamp comparison.

nodes.label: F3 Weekly Pulse
nodes.rationale: One submission per form_id+member_id; question types rating, pill-select, text.

nodes.label: F4 Member Hub (5 Tabs)
nodes.rationale: Feed, My Events, Documents, Directory, Weekly Pulse.

nodes.label: F8 About Page CMS Story + Board
nodes.norm_label: f8 about page cms story + board

nodes.label: ProjectShuffler (DB-driven)
nodes.rationale: Replaces hardcoded initiative array; spring-bounce card cycling from initiatives table.

nodes.label: Mobile Hamburger Pill Dropdown
nodes.rationale: lg:hidden hamburger; AnimatePresence expands pill height; outside-click close.

nodes.label: Mobile Breakpoint Targets 360px+
nodes.rationale: 360/375/768/1024 manual verify; pure Tailwind + Framer Motion; no data layer changes.

nodes.label: RLS Admin Role Gate
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 policies check profiles.role=admin; Phase 3 policies check users.role=admin.

nodes.label: 13-Step Implementation Sequence
nodes.rationale: Migrations → tokens → theme → navbar → homepage → initiatives → announcements → hub → pulse → admin → gallery → about → polish/mobile.
